criteria_location: SI section pp.24-27 of 34: general definitions (conservative management, failure, symptom severity) inside 'Clinical Indications' p.24-25, Patient Requirements p.25, diagnostic/therapeutic/repeat p.25-26, Exclusions p.26. Cross-cutting repeat/simultaneous rules in General Clinical Guideline pp.4-5.
procedures_covered: Excluded: sacral lateral branch blocks, RF ablation (CPT 27096, 64451, 64625, G0260 listed)

logic.top_level: all (Patient Requirements) then procedure-specific sub-rules (diagnostic, therapeutic, repeat)

k_of_n.quote: At least ONE of the following provocative tests is positive

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Exclusions section: 'Indications other than those addressed in this guideline are considered not medically necessary including ... on the same day as other spine injection procedures; ... in a previously fused sacroiliac joint; Use of corticosteroid with diagnostic ... injections; sacral lateral branch blocks; RF'. Radiculopathy handled as conditional inside Patient Requirements.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: 'An injection is considered a repeat injection if the last injection was performed within the previous 12 months. If 12 months or more have elapsed, it is considered a new (initial) injection.' Repeat needs >= 50% relief and ADL improvement for >= 6 weeks; not < 3 months apart; max 3 in 12 months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Conservative management should include a combination of strategies ... including physical therapy AND at least one complementary conservative treatment strategy.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three overlapping definitions (conservative management, complementary management, complementary treatment) with different option lists.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: relief of the primary (index) pain and the onset and minimum duration of relief is consistent with the local anesthetic agent employed
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second diagnostic block 'only if' first is positive; is the second block also required, or optional?

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The specific requirements take precedence over any stated general requirement.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Precedence rule means general rules can be silently overridden.

requirement_kinds.quote: persistent typically unilateral non-radicular pain that is predominantly below the lumbar spine (L5) ... present for at least 3 months
localized tenderness with palpation over the sacral sulcus just inferior to the posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS)
At least ONE of the following provocative tests is positive: pelvic distraction, lateral iliac compression, sacral compression/thrust, thigh thrust, FABER, Gaenslen's
no evidence of acute or subacute radicular pain/radiculopathy or neurogenic claudication
Lack of adequate improvement following 6 weeks of conservative management
physical therapy AND at least one complementary conservative treatment strategy
pain that is at least 3 out of 10 in intensity and is associated with inability to perform at least two (2) ADLs and/or IADLs
second confirmatory injection ... only if the first injection produces at least 75% relief
Anesthetic volume must be limited to 1.5 cc; Total injection volume should be limited to 2.0 cc
Injections may not be repeated at intervals of less than 3 months, with a maximum of three (3) injections in a 12-month period
Procedures must be performed with image guidance, either fluoroscopy or CT. Ultrasound is the only imaging guidance appropriate for use during pregnancy.
All imaging must be performed and read by an independent radiologist

thresholds.quote: Lack of adequate improvement following 6 weeks of conservative management
the patient's pain must be at least 3 out of 10 in severity at rest or during a consistently provocative maneuver
at least 50% pain relief, and improvement in patient-specific ADLs, for at least 6 weeks
Injections may not be repeated at intervals of less than 3 months
maximum of three (3) injections in a 12-month period
A maximum of only 2 diagnostic unilateral (same side) intraarticular injections

time_windows.quote: If 12 months or more have elapsed, it is considered a new (initial) injection.
for at least 6 weeks after a previous injection

codes.non_covered_code_lists: Codes 64451 and 64625 appear though the guideline excludes lateral branch blocks and RF

extraction_hazards: Redline: revisions shown as blue underline/red strikethrough; text contains both old and new words fused, e.g. 'nerve rootneural elements', 'glucocorticoidscorticosteroids', '20243', 'Effective Date: 04/14/2024 04/09/2023'
Three SI-relevant definitions of conservative management in one block
Footnote markers 1, 2 and * carry conditions ('In the absence of contraindications')
Vendor guideline contains 5 other procedures; SI is pp.24-27 of 34
Page breaks mid-list (diagnostic list splits pp.25-26)
interesting_structures: Conservative management defined as PT + one complementary strategy with an 'exception in unusual circumstances'
Repeat vs initial determined by 12-month look-back
Volume limits (1.5 cc, 2.0 cc) as procedural criteria
Diagnostic injection tied to planned fusion only

fit_to_tree.why: Clear numbers, but definitions are nested and overridable; dependency on unrecorded drug/onset facts; peer-to-peer fallback.
